title: My Hitbox
description: Allows you to view your own hitbox in first person.
body:
# My Hitbox

A simple Fabric mod for Minecraft that lets you see your own player hitbox in first person.

## What it does

Vanilla Minecraft already shows hitboxes when you press F3+B, but it skips your own when you're in first person. This mod fixes that by rendering your hitbox even in first person view.

## Usage

- Press **F3+B** to enable hitboxes (vanilla)
- Press **H** (rebindable in Controls) to toggle your own first person hitbox on/off

Both need to be on for it to show up.
